_comment: MCP servers for J.A.R.V.I.S. Copy config/mcp_servers.example.json to
config/mcp_servers.json and edit. Same format as Claude Desktop / Cursor,
so an existing config can be pasted in unchanged.
command        (required) executable name or absolute path
env            (optional) extra env vars for the child process
enabled        (optional, default true) set false to keep it configured
auto_start     (optional, default false) start at boot instead of on
first use. Leave false for anything slow
Servers that are not installed are disabled with a clear reason instead of
crashing the assistant. Use 'mcp status' in chat to see what is running.
The child process inherits only a minimal environment (PATH, HOME, etc.),

websift.description: Web search + page fetch, no API key needed. Install: pip install websift[mcp]

chrome-devtools.description: Google's official Chrome DevTools MCP — real DOM inspection, clicking, typing, console + network capture.

filesystem.description: Scoped filesystem access. Enable ONLY with paths you are happy to expose. Keep disabled by default — the assistant already has full local file control via file_controller.

memory.description: Knowledge-graph memory. Disabled by default — JARVIS already has SQLite FTS5 memory in core/unified_memory.py, so this would duplicate it.

agentic-store.description: LLM prompt firewall + audit logging + 31 privacy tools. Install: pip install agentic-store-mcp. Enable if you want an outbound-prompt inspector in front of the cloud LLM.
